requirements.description: The rendezvous to fly, in order (one to six). Each shows its instruction and only the controls it needs: the burn always, the laps when it allows more than one, the fuel when it has a budget. When you change one, change its instruction and the text version of the block too.

a11y.description: Three-quarter view of the Earth from space, with day and night sides, clouds and a thin atmosphere. A circular orbit 500 km up carries your spacecraft (orange) and a satellite (violet), each with a tag; the satellite's tag says how far ahead or behind it is. When you fly a manoeuvre, your spacecraft burns at the burn point, flies its laps below or above the circle, then burns back at the same point. In 3D the distance between the two craft is magnified; the tag gives the true distance.
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches the controls of the open rendezvous: the burn slider (arrow keys, 0.5 m/s steps), the laps when there is a choice (arrow keys) and Fly. Shortcuts: R brakes 0.5 m/s more, P speeds up 0.5 m/s more, 1 to 3 set the laps, X flies, Space pauses a manoeuvre.
a11y.dragAlternative: Dragging the view turns the camera around the Earth; nothing in the activity needs it.
